garage.description: Return a member’s vehicle to the garage

fiche.description: Show a member’s RP character sheet

errors.offline: 🔴 The FiveM server is not connected to Kron right now.
errors.timeout: ⏳ The FiveM server didn’t answer in time. Try again.
errors.not_linked: This member never joined the city with Discord open: no linked FiveM account.
errors.unsupported: This action isn’t supported by the server’s framework yet.
errors.failed: The FiveM server refused the action.
errors.disabled: This feature is disabled in the dashboard.

unstuck.online: 📍 Player teleported to the safe spot.
unstuck.offline: 📍 Position reset to the safe spot: the player will spawn there next time.

status.hint: Generate a token, install the resource, then restart your server.

web.tokenHint: Copy it now: it won’t be shown again. Keep it secret (like a password). Generating a new token disables the old one.

install.title: Install the Kron resource
install.s2: 2. Unzip it in your server’s resources folder
install.s3: 3. Add these lines to your server.cfg (after oxmysql and your framework)
install.tokenHint: Generate a token on this page first, then replace YOUR_TOKEN.
install.s4hint: The status turns green in under a minute.
install.requirements: Requires: OneSync, oxmysql, and QBCore or Qbox (ESX soon). Players need Discord open for their account to be linked.

web.featuresHint: Choose what Kron may do with your server’s info.

tickets.name: FiveM profile in tickets
tickets.hint: Each ticket header shows the player’s characters.

reports.name: In-city /report
reports.hint: In-game /report goes to Discord, staff answer in the thread. Off: the resource adds no /report, your server keeps its own.

unstuck.name: Unstuck a player
unstuck.hint: Staff button: teleports the character to the safe spot.

garage.name: Return a vehicle
garage.hint: Staff button: puts a vehicle back in the garage.

jobs.name: Job channels
jobs.hint: Off by default. Needs resource 1.2.0 or later.

board.name: Player board
board.hint: One always up-to-date message: players online, slots, jobs on duty. Needs resource 1.4.0.

sheets.name: RP sheets
sheets.hint: Staff write one sheet per character (📜 button on the profile). Anyone can read it with /fiche.

web.fieldsHint: Only show what your staff needs.
web.staffHint: These roles can see profiles and use Unstuck / Garage. The Timeout Members permission also works.
web.reportsHint: Each /report creates a thread in this channel. Write in the thread: the player gets your answer in game.
web.reportsUsage: In game: /report <message>. While the report is open, new /report messages go to the same thread.
web.jobsHint: A JOBS category with one private channel per job or gang of the FiveM server: staff see it, and so do members with the job's Discord role. A “permanent ticket” per job.
web.boardHint: Kron posts one message in this channel and updates it every minute with the FiveM server’s info.
web.boardCreated: Channel created: the board shows up within a minute.
web.boardUsage: Jobs come from the framework (QBCore/Qbox): police and EMS on duty are also in the {fivem.police} and {fivem.ems} tags.
web.sheetsHint: One sheet per character: name, age, occupation, story, image. Staff create it from a member’s FiveM profile (/fivem profil or a ticket header).
web.sheetsEmpty: No sheets yet. Open a member’s profile and click 📜 RP sheet.
web.sheetInvalid: Sheet rejected: check the name and the image URL (https only).

sheet.name: Character name
sheet.invalid: Sheet rejected: check the name and the image URL (https only).
